caption: The drawing depicts a single-breasted vest with a detailed front view as the main subject and a simple outline of the back view in the upper right corner. The vest is composed of a dense, repeating vertical pattern of small brown shapes on a beige background, covering the majority of the front panels. The armholes, collar, front opening, pocket edges, and hem are outlined with solid brown trim. The vest features five brown buttons along the right side of the front opening, and three horizontal slit pockets with brown borders on the left panel; two are parallel and placed above each other on the upper section and one larger pocket is positioned lower. The vest’s back view is rendered as a thin, uncolored line drawing, showing a simple outline without any detailed pattern or coloring. The entire drawing is set against a plain, light beige background.
title: Vest
